UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; Base=${HM_PG_BASE_DIR:?}; PostgreSQLRelease=${HM_PG_RELEASE:?}; PostgreSQLVersion=${HM_PG_VERSION:?}; ExpectedSha256=${HM_PG_SOURCE_SHA256:?}; [[ \"$Base\" == /*/ ]] || { echo 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'; Current=\"${Base}pgsql\"; if [[ -e \"$Data/postmaster.pid\" ]]; then echo 'Refusing update while postmaster.pid exists; stop PostgreSQL cleanly and investigate stale PID files'; exit 1; fi; if [[ -x \"$Current/bin/pg_isready\" ]] && \"$Current/bin/pg_isready\" --host=\"${Base}run\" --port=\"${PGPORT:?}\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f \"${Current}.next\"; ln -s \"$Prefix\" \"${Current}.next\"; if [[ -e \"$Current\" && ! -L \"$Current\" ]]; then mv \"$Current\" \"${Base}releases/legacy-$(date +%s)\"; fi; mv -Tf \"${Current}.next\" \"$Current\"; printf '%s\\n' \"$PostgreSQLVersion\" > \"${Base}selected-release\"; echo 'Verified OpenSSL-enabled PostgreSQL release already installed'; exit 0; fi; if [[ -e \"$Prefix\" ]]; then mv \"$Prefix\" \"${Prefix}.invalid.$(date +%s)\"; fi; BuildRoot=\"${Base}build/postgresql-${PostgreSQLVersion}-$(date +%s)\"; mkdir -p \"$BuildRoot\"; cd \"$BuildRoot\"; wget --https-only -O \"postgresql-${PostgreSQLVersion}.tar.gz\" \"https://ftp.postgresql.org/pub/source/v${PostgreSQLVersion}/postgresql-${PostgreSQLVersion}.tar.gz\"; printf '%s  %s\\n' \"$ExpectedSha256\" \"postgresql-${PostgreSQLVersion}.tar.gz\" | sha256sum -c -; mkdir source; tar -xzf \"postgresql-${PostgreSQLVersion}.tar.gz\" -C source --strip-components=1; cd source; exit 1; }; rm -f \"${Current}.next\"; ln -s \"$Prefix\" \"${Current}.next\"; if [[ -e \"$Current\" && ! -L \"$Current\" ]]; then mv \"$Current\" \"${Base}releases/legacy-$(date +%s)\"; fi; mv -Tf \"${Current}.next\" \"$Current\"; printf '%s\\n' \"$PostgreSQLVersion\" > \"${Base}selected-release\"; echo 'Installed and selected checksum-verified OpenSSL-enabled PostgreSQL'"

UpdateStageName: Initialize PostgreSQL and enforce TLS-only remote HBA
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; Base=${HM_PG_BASE_DIR:?}; AllowedDatabase=${HM_PG_ALLOWED_DATABASE:?}; AllowedRole=${HM_PG_ALLOWED_ROLE:?}; AllowedIPv4CIDR=${HM_PG_ALLOWED_IPV4_CIDR:?}; AllowedIPv6CIDR=${HM_PG_ALLOWED_IPV6_CIDR:?}; [[ \"$Base\" == /*/ ]] || { echo 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedDatabase\" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid allowed database identifier'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedRole\" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid allowed role identifier'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedIPv4CIDR\" =~ ^[0-9./]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid IPv4 CIDR characters'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedIPv6CIDR\" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F:./]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid IPv6 CIDR characters'; exit 1; }; cd \"$Base\"; if [[ ! -f \"${Base}data/PG_VERSION\" ]]; then pgsql/bin/initdb --pgdata=\"${Base}data\" --auth-local=peer --auth-host=reject --username=amp; echo 'Initialized PostgreSQL with local peer authentication and remote reject defaults'; fi; Hba=\"${Base}data/pg_hba.conf\"; umask 077; printf '%s\\n' 'local all amp peer' 'local all all scram-sha-256' 'hostnossl all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject' 'hostnossl all all ::0/0 reject' \"hostssl $AllowedDatabase $AllowedRole $AllowedIPv4CIDR scram-sha-256\" \"hostssl $AllowedDatabase $AllowedRole $AllowedIPv6CIDR scram-sha-256\" > \"$Hba\"; echo 'Installed deterministic TLS-only remote HBA rules'"
